But will all the cooking at Youkai Academy find a way to Tsukune's stomach and heart or will all attempts be in vain?

But Saya's unruffled life is about to change: when she accidentally meets a handsome cell

Then Saya faints on the spot... The next day, the incident is treated as a murder committed by a drug addicted American soldier, and there seems to be no trace of the creature. Saya is shocked, but a new menace is just approaching, its eyes shining red...

Full of anger, Kai takes out a Colt M1911 that his father was keeping secretly hidden, and goes alone after the man -or whatever it was- responsible for that hell, ignoring Riku who tries to stop him.
